description.en: An array of IPv4 address ranges for the custom line. Specify each range in the `StartIP-EndIP` format.
The language of the response. Valid values: `en` and `zh`. Default value: `en`.
The unique ID of the custom line.
The name of the custom line.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun pvtz update-custom-line --lang en --line-id 100003 --name Test --ipv4s 1.1.1.1-2.2.2.2 --dns-category example-string --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun pvtz UpdateCustomLine --region cn-hangzhou --LineId 100003 --Lang en --Ipv4s.1 '1.1.1.1-2.2.2.2' --DnsCategory 'example-string' --Name Test
